name: EX Team Magma vs Team Aqua

releases.name: EX Team Magma vs Team Aqua

description.text: The fourth set of the EX series, released on 15 March 2004 with 97 cards, 95 numbered and two secret rares, Absol and Jirachi, and two theme decks, Team Aqua and Team Magma. It is built around the two villainous teams of Ruby and Sapphire and brought owner's Pokémon back to English for the first time in four years: a team's Pokémon evolve only from that team's Pokémon. It also brought in dual-type Pokémon, all of them part Darkness for their owners, and it was the last set with e-Reader dot codes.
